title: A University Deadline
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A University Deadline. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: Students who submitted their applications before the original deadline do not need to do anything else. The deadline has been extended by four days because of technical problems with the website. However, applicants who saved an unfinished form must return to the portal and press Submit; saving a draft does not count as applying.

options: Saving a draft is not submitting an application
